releases.notes:
# NBT Editor 2.2.0-26.2 Changelog

**Scope**: a56d7a7 → 3e277a4  (4 commits)  
**Changes**: 22 files, +922 / -104 lines

---

## ✨ New Features

### 1. Entity Attributes Screen (`EntityAttributesScreen`)
Added a new "Entity Attributes" entry in the advanced editor factory menu for editing an entity's NBT attribute list and boolean tags.
Supported: current/max Health, movement_speed / attack_damage / follow_range, NoAI / Invulnerable / NoGravity / Silent / CanBreatheUnderwater / FireImmune, FallDistance / AbsorptionAmount / Air, Baby for AgeableMobs.

### 2. Spawn Egg Entity Data Screen (`SpawnEggAttributesScreen`)
A spawn-egg-exclusive entity NBT editor that directly manipulates the `entity_data` component (`TypedEntityData<EntityType<?>>`) — no entity loading required.
Includes every attribute from `EntityAttributesScreen`, plus these extras:
- Entity type switcher (searchable dropdown, change what the spawn egg generates at runtime)
- CustomNameVisible / Glowing boolean toggles
- PersistenceRequired / CanPickUpLoot (Mob-only, conditionally shown)
- Villager trading editor entry (only for Villager / Zombie Villager — reuses `VillagerScreen` bridged via an anonymous `NBTReference`)
- Entries conditionally shown by current `entityType` (`isMob` / `canBeBaby`) — after save, Mob-exclusive, AgeableMob-only, and Villager button entries automatically appear or disappear

### 3. Shared Entity Attribute Utilities (`EntityAttrsUtil` + `EntityAttrState`)
Common code shared between the two new screens to avoid duplication:

| API | Purpose |
|-----|---------|
| `EntityAttrState` (enum) | `KEEP` / `ON` / `OFF` — three-state toggle |
| `EntityAttrsUtil.BABY_AGE = -24000` | Minecraft vanilla baby Age constant |
| `getAttributeBase(nbt, attributeId)` | Look up a base value in the attributes ListTag by id; returns -1 if not found |
| `setAttributeBase(nbt, attributeId, value)` | Updates an existing entry or creates a new full `{id, base, modifiers:[]}` entry |
| `applyBooleanTag(nbt, key, dropdown)` | Applies the three-state value to NBT; skips when dropdown is null (supports conditional entries) |
| `titleWithCurrent(langKey, current)` | Translated label + " (current: on/off)" suffix so users see the NBT value at a glance |

### 4. LocalEditorScreen Save Button Text Differentiation
Previously all editors showed "Save Item". Now the label branches on `localNBT` type:
- `LocalItem` → `nbteditor.editor.save` ("Save Item")
- Others (entities/blocks) → `nbteditor.editor.save_changes` ("Save Changes")

---

## 🛠 New Feature Infrastructure

| Change | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `LocalEditorScreen.onAfterSave()` hook | Called inside the save success callback; subclasses override to rebuild UI |
| `ConfigPanel.setConfig(ConfigPath)` | `toRender` no longer final, `elements` changed from `List.of()` to `ArrayList` — swap the internal ConfigCategory at runtime without destroying the Panel widget itself (avoids Screen.children stacking issues) |
| `LocalFactoryScreen` registers two new factory entries | `entity_attributes` (EntityReference) + `spawn_egg_attributes` (SpawnEggItem) |
| SpawnEggAttributesScreen selector timing | Entity type selector listener only writes NBT + `checkSave()`. UI rebuild **only** happens post-save via `onAfterSave` |

---

## 🐛 Existing Bug Fixes

### 1. Save button occasionally stays gray (`MainUtil.copyAirable`)
**Root cause**: Under Fabric Data Components, `item.transmuteCopy(item.getItem(), item.getCount())` does a **shallow copy** — the component patch's internal Tag/Map objects are shared references with the original. `LocalEditorScreen` calls `copyAirable` twice during construction, so `localNBT.item` and `savedLocalNBT.item` end up pointing to the **same component patch object**. Any edit to local simultaneously pollutes saved → `ItemStack.matches` always returns true → save button stays permanently disabled.  
**Fix**: Use vanilla `item.copy()` which does a full deep copy of all component data.

releases.notes:
d65fe5f308952b942c6ec406a6c67edc4e8a97c4 ~ a6d5c8b590eb2400f8dae07caa2108e0494579ec
## What's Changed

### 🆕 New: Villager Trade Editor (now in the factory)
- **Full villager trade editor** — edit trades (Purchase A / Purchase B / Sale, prices, counts, and per-trade NBT); changes persist after re-entering the world.
- **Server-side NBT fetching**: on 26.2 the client-side entity snapshot doesn't contain `Offers`, so the editor automatically requests the entity NBT from the server and rebuilds itself.
- **New item selection overlay** with search (by Chinese name or ID), hover highlighting, click-to-select, Confirm/Cancel — and a **Clear** button for the purchase-B slot.
- **"Save and Return" flow for trade NBT**: saving an item's NBT returns to the villager editor; the whole factory chain (NBT / Enchantments / Attributes / Containers, …) now shows a "Save and Return" button that returns to the previous screen after saving.

### 🐛 Fixes
- **Villager `Offers` failed to load/save**: server-side entity serialization now uses a registry-aware `DynamicOps` (`level.registryAccess().createSerializationContext`), so `MerchantOffers → ItemCost → Item.CODEC` is no longer silently dropped; the read path now prefers `subject.level().registryAccess()` instead of the vanilla fallback (datapack items no longer lost).
- **Ender Chest changes not working / MC-69683**: enchanted ender-chest glow was lost under 26.2's deferred rendering; switched to `RenderTypes.entityGlint()` redraw (matching the Trident renderer).
- **Container title missing / server permissions not resolved**: container title color now passes the alpha-channel check (`-12566464`); `ServerMixinLink` detects 26.1+ client listeners via reflection fallback, restoring permission checks in single-player.
- **Item selection overlay not clickable / no hover highlight**: entries now use local-coordinate-based `isHovering` checks.
- **Right-click context menu crash (NPE)**: `List2D` guards against a null `finalEventHandler`.

### 🔧 Other
- **Skull database expansion**: `/headdb` (alias `/hdb`) command with paged view, larger database, and updated translations.
- **Layout polish**: trade main screen no longer overlaps Buy/Sell labels; trade item NBT editing restored the advanced editor (factory) entry.
- Lang updates for `en_us`, `zh_cn`, `zh_tw`.
